references.text: Thematic parallel: Mercy shown by enemies makes it possible for brothers to return to the land.
Identical motif: The father (Jacob) fears losing more of his children in a single day.
Theological parallel: Mercy from a powerful actor enables a journey home to one's own land.
Theological parallel: God's intervention to gather and turn the fate of those who are away.
Thematic parallel: The motif of brothers returning to their own people.
